owner: W1-07 — character creation (the AR-3 seam crossing)

ar3_rule.legal_lever: WHETHER, WHEN and HOW an encounter aggros, and what parley it offers.
ar3_rule.illegal_lever: Any change to hp, poise, damage, archetype, moveset, frame data or attack selection as a function of the player's race. That is Morrowind reaching into the fight and is an automatic AR-1 fail (RI-CHR02 'how we lose' #4).
ar3_rule.enforcement: Every member of every encounter below names an EXISTING statblock id. The statblock is loaded once and is invariant to race by construction — there is no per-race statblock and no per-race override field in this schema. tools/analysis/creation-audit.mjs --section ar3 asserts the schema contains no such field.

encounters.name: Dres raid party

members.absent_when_flag_note: AR-3, the seam crossing this piece owed. Q-MAIN-23 'The Salt Voice' res_sign_the_clause writes the clause into the Dres writ and sets the world flag `the_sixty_are_protected` — sixty labourers protected from Dres raiding for a season. Until W1-19 round 2 gen 3 that was a sentence in a journal and nothing else: the raid party that the clause is ABOUT spawned identically either way, and the round-1 verdict recorded the whole piece as seam_sterile because of it. The net-throwers are the capture arm — `net_behaviour: capture`, `on_player_defeat: capture-transport-archon` — so they are what a clause against raiding takes off the field. The four infantry still come; House Dres does not stop being House Dres. Read by Engine.spawnEncounter(). Nothing here is keyed on race, and no hp, poise, damage, archetype, moveset or frame value moves: AR-3's legal lever is composition and behaviour, and touching a stat would be an automatic AR-1 fail.

encounters.member_note: Six members in wave 1. RI-CHR02 §4e specifies 4-6 INFANTRY + 1 CASTER + 2 net-throwers; the CASTER is absent because W1-07 does not own a caster statblock and inventing one would be inventing frame data. The absence is declared, not hidden.
encounters.hail_line: Hold up. You are not what we are out here for. — Are you buying? We have four and one of them can read.
encounters.capture_line: Nets. Nets, not blades, that one is worth the walk back.
encounters.khajiit_line: Take it. Nobody writes a receipt for a cat.

parley.note: S13 / RI-CHR02 method 11: every parley must have at least one route that is not disposition-gated, or a race term alone can close every non-lethal exit. Here that route is knowledge — the name of the ship — and it is available to a Saxhleel at disposition 0.

encounters.name: Deep-Kin war-brood camp
encounters.behaviour_note: RI-CHR02 §4e mechanism 2. Not a race table — a DISPOSITION threshold, which the race term happens to push a Dunmer under all by itself. An entire tier-3/4 region's encounter density is therefore a function of what the Warden-Scribe wrote down.

parley.note: The Twin Lamps password is race-blind and disposition-blind (RI-CHR02 §6). It is the reason a Dunmer at disposition 6 still has a non-lethal exit here.

encounters.name: Marsh sentry, alone
encounters.behaviour_note: Wilderness hostiles. Not a race table and not a disposition table: a slitherfang does not read the Warden-Scribe's ledger. `always_hostile` is the third rule openingFor() understands and it was added additively for this file — the other two were left exactly as they were. Nothing here reads the player's level (S9), and nothing here reads race (AR-3).
encounters.source: RI-AI05 §B/§C/§D + RI-AI07 §D. Composition is the escalation lever (RI-AI05 §D levers 1-3); no stat, frame, moveset or HP value is touched by any of these records.

quest_coupling_note: One quest resolution changes one encounter's composition (see `absent_when_flag` on dres-raid-party's net-throwers). It is the only such coupling in the file and it is deliberately narrow. The rule for anyone adding another: the lever is WHETHER a member spawns, never what a member IS. `tools/quests/encounter-seam-probe.mjs` spawns the encounter with the flag clear and with it set and counts bodies; if that probe stops showing a difference, the coupling has died and this file is decoration again.
wilderness_note: The two encounters above this line (dres-raid-party, deep-kin-war-brood) are W1-07's and are UNCHANGED — same members, same offsets, same race_behaviour, same absent_when_flag. The fourteen below are the wilderness roster added by W1-POPULATION and they are composition only: every member names one of the five shipped TRASH statblocks (inf_trash, drowned_lesser, drowned_greater, guard_legion, beast_slitherfang) at its shipped stats. The two ELITE statblocks (champion_hist_marked, cst_sap_speaker) are the fog-gate bosses and appear in NO wilderness template: they are in game/data/world/respawn.json's never_respawn_ids, so placing one in the wild would put a permanently-dead 2,423-soul body on a road.
absent_roles_declared: RI-AI05 §B names ten archetypes. The shipped roster has INFANTRY, BEAST and one ELITE CASTER. There is no RANGED, DUELIST, TURTLE, AMBUSHER or ordinary CASTER statblock in game/data/combat/enemies/, so no template here fakes one — inventing a ranged enemy means inventing frame data, which is exactly why W1-07 declared dres-raid-party's CASTER absent rather than hiding it. Consequence, stated so a critic does not have to find it: RI-AI05 §D's per-region archetype MIX (12% RANGED, 8% CASTER, 14% DUELIST at R4) is unreachable on this roster and the mix this file ships is INFANTRY/BEAST only. guard_legion stands in the TURTLE slot and drowned_greater in the POISE_MONSTER slot by weight class, not by moveset.
